targets.rawSql: SELECT sumIf(amount_minor, event_type = 'OrderConfirmed') AS revenue_minor FROM analytics.order_events_v2 FINAL WHERE event_date >= today() - 7
SELECT event_date, event_type, count() AS events FROM analytics.order_events_v2 FINAL WHERE event_date >= today() - 7 GROUP BY event_date, event_type ORDER BY event_date LIMIT 100
